additional_info.subject: ID0443364-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP/RD 170003116] Charger is offline CRM:02889000411
additional_info.body:
Dear Islam, I hope you are doing well.
Since the charger is offline in our backend, are you able to restart it yourself? Please do not forget to follow safety instructions if you are to operate the charger with open door.
We need to connect to the Routers and understand if the Signal strength is bad or good. If it's bad, then it's a network coverage issue.
If the signal is good, then we can try factory resetting the router in the back button or via frontend.
Let me know what is best for you.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0443364-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP/RD 170003116] Charger is offline CRM:02889000411
additional_info.body:
Hello Islam, good afternoon.
After today's site visit, we were not able to recover XF3 as it is corrupted, we have seen multiple IPs being created by the router.
We tried restoring the configuration, doing a factory reset multiple times unsucessfully.
For your backend router we checked it and at first sight, the router seems to be working fine:
We can see that the router can reach the bands and the RSSI and RSRP are Excellent, which are the priority values.
The limited service means:
After a few seconds of trying to reach the network, it says "Denied".
My first idea is to use a SIM Card from the "STC" provider which I checked with a different charger and it's working perfectly.
The second point is that we should ask the network provider if there is any kind of constraint that is not visible to us to better understand why it's not connecting.
TOmorrow we will continue at your 12:30pm.
Thank you and see you tomorrow.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0443364-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP/RD 170003116] Charger is offline CRM:02889000411
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco,
Thank you for your time today and for the detailed update on the charger's status. We appreciate your efforts in troubleshooting the issue.
We are looking forward to tomorrow's intervention, especially with the suggestion to use an STC SIM card. We hope this approach will resolve the connectivity issue, and that the network operator is indeed the root cause. We did receive internal feedback that an STC SIM card was attempted previously without success, but we are optimistic that it will work this time.
In case the STC SIM card does not resolve the issue, we would appreciate it if you could explore further troubleshooting possibilities.
Regarding the XF3 modem, we are quite concerned about replacing it from one of our warehoused chargers. We have faced this situation before with the same charger, and we are still awaiting a spare part for it.
Thank you again for your continued support. See you tomorrow at 12:30 PM.
Best regards,
Islam E. Dakroury

additional_info.subject: ID0443364-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP/RD 170003116] Charger is offline CRM:02889000411
additional_info.body:
Hello Mohannad and Islam,
After today's site visit, we were able to bring the charger to the OCPP backend properly. But since there was a reboot on the charger and the Router 1 was corrupted, the charger went into Failsafemode making it unrecoverable without another router.
We did all the steps from the wiki of the supplier and the Router is still corrupted, we see 3 different IPs for the router in the network which is impossible.
For now, we need to have a new router installed. If you have a spare one from another charger, be aware that we need to change the password before plugging in.
If you have a brand new router, it should be plug and play, no configuration needed as the charger auto performs this task.
@Mohannad I will send this ticket to your region, when you are ready to start the replacement, please reach out to me via Teams.
Thank you and have a nice day.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: 0443364 - ID0443364-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP/RD 170003116] Charger is offline CRM:00472000408
additional_info.body:
Dear Islam,
After our intervention last Wednesday (08-10-2025), we were able to fix the charger.
We had to factory reset and configure both routers, flash the cfast card and run the restore config script.
After some troubleshoot in the routers, we were able to have the charger online in both backends and the outlets are available.
I will now close this ticket.
Thank you for your support and assist during the intervention.
